Text:
## Vaccine route, orders, names
## __________________________
## Route: IM
## Outpatient MenB orders:
[3 dose series](orz-set-abx-op-meningococcal-b-vaccine-2-dose-series)
[Booster Dose](psczid-meningococcal-b-vaccine-one-dose)
## CPRS name:
MENINGOCOCCAL B VACCINE
INJ,SUSP
## Stocked brand name:
Bexsero
## Other names:
Meningococcal serogroup B
(MenB)
References:
Immunization Action
Coalition,
Summary of Adult
Immunizations, 2021, P2011
Freedman et al., Annals of
internal medicine, 2021,
174(3)374-384.
<!-- COLUMN 2 -->
## Recommended populations
## __________________________
*People with anatomic or
functional asplenia or
persistent complement
component deficiency.
*Microbiologists routinely
exposed to isolates of N.
meningitidis.
*People identified as at
a serogroup B
meningococcal disease
outbreak.
*Young adults through age
23yrs may be vaccinated
routinely.
<!-- COLUMN 3 -->
## Administration Schedule
## __________________________
*Give 3 dose series at
at 0, 1-2months,and 6months
*For people with continuing
risk (see 1st-3rd bullets
in column to left), give a
booster 1 year after
completing the primary
series, followed by a
booster every 2-3 years as
long as risk continues.
Booster doses must be same
brand as primary series.
*MenB vaccine may be given
concomitantly with MenACWY
vaccine
<!-- COLUMN 4 -->
## Contraindications/Precautions
## __________________________
## Contraindications:
History of severe allergic
reaction (e.g.,
anaphylaxis) to a previous
dose or a vaccine
component.
## Precautions:
*Moderate or severe acute
illness with or
without fever.
*Pregnancy
